title: 01_frontier_and_runtime
interpretation: Every simulation method on the sepsis core placed on one speed-vs-fidelity frontier (left) plus the same-harness runtime (right, 2 h severity-3). Exact engines (BioGears/Tellurium/COPASI/Rust) cluster at ~1x speed and <1% error; proto_valve and the event-driven hybrid sit just above 1x inside the exact-fidelity band (~1e-3, 233-236 s vs 284 s); the mean-hemodynamics reduction (~5.6e7x) and the PyTorch surrogate (~4e4x, inadmissible) trade orders of magnitude of speed for fidelity. The hybrid's blood-pathogen transient is shown as a faint secondary point. Runtimes are same-engine/same-Composite-harness for the 3 roadrunner methods; the accelerated tiers (annotated) are committed numbers at their own horizons.
